Name: Clima Pro
Description: Live weather on your keys, in the theme you choose, with official Defesa Civil alerts in Brazil. Weather data by WeatherAPI.com, for general information only: never the sole basis for safety-critical decisions.

Actions.Name: Weather
Actions.Tooltip: Show the weather. Press to switch screens.

Localization.alerts.clear: The feed has no alert for this place.
Localization.alerts.stale: The last alert check is getting old, so there may be newer alerts.
Localization.alerts.unavailable: Could not check for alerts. This does not mean there are none.
Localization.alerts.disabled: Alerts are off for this key.
Localization.alerts.outside: Alerts are off for this place because the Defesa Civil only covers Brazil.
Localization.alerts.note: Brazil only. Official alerts from the public Defesa Civil feed (IDAP). Some alerts sent to phones may not appear in it, so this does not replace official channels. While the key is on screen it downloads the feed about every 5 minutes, several MB each time.
Localization.status.missing: Paste your WeatherAPI.com key to start.
Localization.status.format: This does not look like a WeatherAPI.com key.
Localization.status.quota: This key has used up its monthly calls.
Localization.status.server: WeatherAPI.com is not answering correctly. Retrying.
Localization.disclaimer: Weather information displayed here is provided for general informational purposes only. Forecasts and conditions are probabilistic and may not be accurate for your specific location or time. This data should not be used as the sole basis for decisions involving personal safety, aviation, marine navigation, emergency planning, or other safety-critical activities. Always consult official meteorological services and relevant authorities for decisions where accuracy is critical.
